name: @vhyxvoid/middleware
description: Zero-config tunnel middleware for Express, Fastify, and Next.js

scripts.build: tsc -b && esbuild src/index.ts --platform=node --bundle --external:express --external:fastify --external:fastify-plugin --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/next.ts --platform=node --bundle --outfile=dist/next.js && esbuild src/fastify.ts --platform=node --bundle --external:fastify --external:fastify-plugin --outfile=dist/fastify.js && node ../../scripts/check-dist.mjs dist/index.js dist/next.js dist/fastify.js
